description:
Record the measurement units to show this customer their artwork sizes in.

Sizes default to IMPERIAL (inches) — the US market. Call this ONLY when the
customer explicitly asks to see METRIC (mm/cm), or asks to switch back. The
choice sticks for the rest of the session and applies to every prepress and
artwork-spec surface, including the upload page.

unit.description:
The measurement system a customer's geometry is rendered in. A session
preference, default imperial; distinct from `artifex.product.UnitFormat`, the
upstream wire tag that is normalised to mm at ingest and discarded.

name: session_set_units

anyOf.description:
Canonical short-circuit response shape.

`status` is always `"error"` — acts as a discriminator for LLM consumers.
`error` is a machine-readable code (e.g. `session_not_found`).
`reason` is a human-readable explanation of why the call failed.
`detail` carries structured extra context (ids, available values, etc.).
